title: Aye Shaame Gareebaan
body:
Aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Be gooro kafan ran mein hai shabbir ka lasha
Zehra ke jigar band ka sar hai sar-e-naiza
Mazloom ke lashe pe jafakaar darinde daudate hain ghoode, pamaale sitam hota hai Ahmed kanawasa aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Rone ki sada aati hai maqtal ki fiza se aur arzo sama se, shabbir ke lashe pe fughaan karti hai zehra aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Balwe me khule sar hai khadi dukhtar e haider sab aale payamber, sehti hai sitam ranj o alam saaniye zehra aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Sherane Ali ladte hue fauj e jafa se maare gaye pyaase, aur qaid mein sahil ke tadapta raha dariya aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Baazo bhi kate mashq chidi margaya saqa pyaasi hai Sakina, ghazi ka badan kaanp raha hai labe dariya aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Is haal me bhi shukre khuda lab pa hai paiham larza hai do aalam, jalti hui reti pa wo beemar ka sajda aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Marker bhi sukoon pa na saka qabar me Asghar bano ka dilbar, turbat se nikala gaya masoom ka laasha aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Asbaab luta jata hai aur jalte hai qaime har simt hai sholay, qaidiye sitam hota shabbir ka kunba aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Be goar hai maidan mein bikhre hue laashe sab ahle wafa ke, maqtal ki fiza karti hai mazloomo pa griya aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahsaan shaheedo ke hai bhudhe ho ke kamseen hai deen ke Mohsin, kaabe ke nighebaano ka ghar lut gaya sara aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Pamaal hua ran mein udhar Qasim e muztar laqte dil e shabbar, bewa hui ek shab ki dulhan Fatima kubra aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Lipta hua sholon se hai beemar ka bistar ghash Abid e muztar, maa dekhti hai jalta hai besheer ka jhoola aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
Har daur mein matam sheh e bekas ka hua hai roke na roka hai, awaaz hai mazloom ki jaweed ka nauha hai aye Shaam-e-gareebaan
